ln:4463703844.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Manage complicated, cross-platform production issues involving Operating Systems, Networking and Databases, including services hosted on external platforms.
  • Operate and continuously improve monitoring and alerting, and support incident response and service restoration.
  • Support and improve CI/CD pipelines and release processes, embedding DevSecOps principles into operational workflows.
  • Agree and develop SLOs/SLIs across engineering teams and with Product Owners, and use them to drive reliability improvements.
  • Engage in new features and builds at inception to ensure operability, stability, and delivery quality before go-live.
  • Build and maintain application & infrastructure performance tooling, and take steps to improve overall production stability.
  • Develop and enhance the existing observability tooling stack (logs/metrics/traces) to improve detection and diagnosis.
  • Contribute to the wider bank community to share technology, run trials on new tools, and scale successful practices.

Requirements

  • Experience in IT Operations / Production Support / Reliability Engineering
  • Solid track record delivering agile projects at scale, ideally in FinTechs or Investment Banks (IBs).
  • Ability to drive operational improvements and influence change in a complex technical environment.
  • Experience building and configuring monitoring/alerting, e.g. AppDynamics, Geneos, Datadog, Splunk, AWS CloudWatch.
  • Software engineering experience (the original template stated 2+ years) in one or more of: Python, Java, C/C++, Ruby, JavaScript, with a focus on automation/tooling.
  • Experience developing or operating enterprise technology in the cloud: AWS, GCP, Azure, ACS.
  • Knowledge on tools and software including Grafana, Docker, OpenAI, Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet, Google Stack Driver
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4430882176.descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

The Principal Engineer in Asia & Middle East Tech (AMET) is a senior technical leader who uplifts engineering capability, efficiency and productivity across multiple teams. You’ll set technical direction, accelerate adoption of modern engineering practices and tooling, and drive responsible integration of AI into the development environment and, where appropriate, production systems—balancing innovation with governance, model risk, explainability and data privacy. You’ll work across boundaries with product, security, risk and operations to deliver resilient outcomes in a regulated environment.

Key responsibilities

  • Drive AI adoption at scale
  • Define and execute an AI adoption roadmap across the engineering organisation (e.g., coding assistance, test generation, incident support, documentation, knowledge search, SDLC automation).
  • Identify high-value use cases, prioritise them with measurable outcomes, and take them from prototype to production.
  • Establish repeatable patterns (playbooks, templates, golden paths) so teams can adopt AI consistently.
  • Technical leadership
  • Design reference patterns for AI-enabled engineering workflows (e.g., RAG for internal knowledge, secure prompt patterns, evaluation harnesses, model routing, guardrails).
  • Lead technical decisions on build vs buy, model selection, integration patterns, and platform capabilities.
  • Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, cloud strategy, and engineering standards.
  • Responsible AI, security, and risk-by-design
  • Embed controls for data handling, privacy, IP protection, and secure SDLC when using AI tools.
  • Partner with Cyber Security, Risk, Compliance, and Legal to ensure safe usage patterns and approvals.
  • Define governance for prompts, datasets, model outputs, and human-in-the-loop review where required.
  • Engineering excellence & transformation outcomes
  • Improve engineering productivity and quality through AI-enabled automation (CI/CD, code review, testing, release, observability).
  • Define and track metrics (e.g., lead time, change failure rate, MTTR, test coverage, defect escape rate, developer satisfaction).
  • Champion modern engineering practices (platform engineering, DevSecOps, SRE, trunk-based development) and show how AI amplifies them.
  • Enablement, coaching, and community building
  • Coach engineers and tech leads on effective AI usage (prompting, evaluation, safe patterns, limitations).
  • Run workshops, office hours, and internal communities of practice; create learning paths and onboarding materials.
  • Mentor senior engineers and help raise the technical bar across teams.
  • Stakeholder management & influence
  • Work closely with Heads of Engineering, Product Owners, Architecture, and Operations to align priorities and remove blockers.
  • Communicate clearly to technical and non-technical audiences; influence without authority across multiple teams and regions.
  • Provide pragmatic guidance—balancing pace with safety, quality, and long-term maintainability.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related discipline; MSc/PhD preferred.
  • 10+ years’ software engineering experience, ideally in financial services or other regulated environments.
  • Proven track record improving engineering capability and delivery outcomes through modern engineering practices, standards and developer tooling.
  • Practical experience applying AI/ML or GenAI in engineering contexts (e.g., copilots, RAG, code intelligence, test generation, incident triage).
  • Experience designing secure, scalable platforms and APIs; familiarity with cloud-native patterns and CI/CD.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, DevSecOps, and production operations (observability, incident management, SRE practices).
  • Excellent communication and coaching skills; able to lead through influence.

Preferred / Nice-to-have

  • Experience building internal developer platforms or “golden paths”.
  • Familiarity with model evaluation, prompt engineering patterns, and guardrail techniques.
  • Experience with regulated environments (financial services) and working with risk/compliance stakeholders.
  • Contributions to internal standards, reusable libraries, open source, research, patents, or speaking at conferences.

ln:4456732165.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering (Knowledge & RAG Platform Engineering Lead).

Business: CTO Platforms (AI Platforms)

Job ID: 56078

Location: Guangzhou / Xi'an

Principal Responsibilities

  • Senior technical IC leadership for knowledge intelligence: Act as a hands-on senior technical expert in knowledge intelligence and knowledge management, shaping architecture, technical direction, and implementation approach for an enterprise-grade knowledge platform.
  • Knowledge platform architecture & delivery ownership: Lead the design and build of scalable platform capabilities across ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification, knowledge asset management, discovery, reuse, governance, and controlled downstream consumption.
  • Industry best practice adoption & engineering standards: Evaluate knowledge management, knowledge engineering, ontology/taxonomy, graph, and AI-assisted curation practices, and translate them into engineering standards, reusable patterns, reference architectures, APIs/SDKs, and runbooks.
  • Knowledge refinement & intelligence workflows: Lead workflows that extract, refine, summarize, classify, deduplicate, consolidate, and contextualize fragmented information into trusted, structured, traceable, and business-aligned knowledge assets.
  • Knowledge graph & semantic layer leadership: Architect and evolve ontology/taxonomy management, entity/relation extraction, entity resolution, graph modeling, graph traversal, lineage-aware context assembly, and graph-based reasoning support for AI and search scenarios.
  • Knowledge lifecycle, governance & self-checking: Establish mechanisms for ownership, validation, versioning, publishing, freshness monitoring, deprecation, retention, rollback, quality scoring, duplication/contradiction detection, and citation/provenance validation.
  • Optimisation & operational readiness: Define SLOs/SLAs, observability, alerting, capacity planning, cost controls, incident response, troubleshooting playbooks, resilience patterns, and continuous production improvement for knowledge platform services.
  • Cross-team influence & enablement: Partner with AI engineering, data platforms, cybersecurity, architecture, product, and domain SMEs to drive adoption, mentor engineers, review designs, unblock complex issues, and communicate trade-offs to senior stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Management, Data Engineering, AI, or a related technical discipline; 7+ years of hands-on engineering experience in backend, data, AI, knowledge, search, or enterprise information platforms.
  • Proven experience as a senior technical IC or platform technical lead, owning architecture, engineering standards, design review, implementation quality, optimisation, and production readiness for complex platform capabilities.
  • Deep knowledge of knowledge intelligence and management practices, including taxonomy/ontology design, metadata standards, knowledge refinement, lifecycle management, governance, lineage, and enterprise content operations.
  • Hands-on experience with knowledge graph, semantic search, RAG, agentic AI, or data enrichment systems, plus strong engineering foundations in distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, observability, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong security, compliance, production, and stakeholder mindset, with the ability to adopt industry best practices, mentor engineers, influence cross-functional teams, and apply AI-native approaches to improve quality, productivity, and decision-making.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4454289241.descriptionHtml:
The China Trade and Working Capital Product Head is a senior management level position responsible for managing a broad range of Product Management employees, setting strategy and providing direction, leadership and budgetary management, etc. Additionally, this role will be responsible for the development of product plans, strategies, and tactics while coordinating product lines through product life-cycles in coordination with the broader Product Management team. The overall objective of this role is to coordinate the promotion of products to develop new markets, increase share of market and obtain competitive position.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of professional to accomplish established goals and conduct personnel duties for team (e.g. performance evaluations, hiring and disciplinary actions) as well as negotiate and make decisions on issues/activities having critical impact/influence on company revenues, capital, or business operations
  • Lead strategic product roadmaps, product development, program launches, and program marketing to gain maximum benefit from each product, as well as survey and analyze competitive industry landscapes to identify relative trends, threats, and opportunities for product managers
  • Manage day-to-day product marketing for core products such as product delivery, client experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results
  • Drive client valued propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to Citi clients
  • Develop plans and execute functional strategies for a country, group of countries, region, or business requiring coordination and integration across units as well as provide input into strategic decisions affecting job family or function within region or business
  • Manage client and competitor market research, develop product innovation roadmap, and address fundamental trials of product commoditization to create an advanced set of solutions
  • Oversee all aspects of program life cycle management including market demands, technology trends, and the competitive field as well as drive innovation by working with external partners/alliances to develop products, manage ongoing relationships, and prepare agreements
  • Manage acquisition targets, product financial performance, revenue performance, and expense management goals as well as oversee identification and execution of opportunities and gaps business plans
  • Define and launch new products, features, and capabilities including defining the product/feature and go-to-market strategy, and participate in technology development and market launch activities
  • Develop and communicate a business plan to approach the marketplace, and coordinate and implement team procedures, client problem resolutions and client management
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience
  • 8-10+ years of managerial experience
  • Experience managing in a global and matrixed environment including managing cross functional areas with direct and indirect reports (e.g. risk, finance, decision management, marketing, operations)
  • Working knowledge of the different systems, theories, and practices relevant to a function as well as practical experience of multiple business cycles
  • In-depth knowledge of industry and competitor products/services

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

------------------------------------------------------

Job Family Group:

Product Management and Development

------------------------------------------------------

Job Family:

Product Management

------------------------------------------------------

Time Type:

Full time

------------------------------------------------------

Most Relevant Skills

Please see the requirements listed above.

------------------------------------------------------

Other Relevant Skills

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

------------------------------------------------------

Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.

View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster.

ln:4466862043.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

As a Relationship Manager, you will build trusted relationships with Priority Banking and Priority Private Banking clients, helping them achieve their wealth goals through tailored investment and portfolio solutions. Supported by specialists in investment, insurance, products, and treasury, you’ll deliver comprehensive strategies that drive long-term growth and stability.

This role gives you the opportunity to demonstrate your expertise in relationship management, sales, and client engagement, while advancing your career across Wealth and Retail Banking or other client segments.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our clients in achieving their financial goals as they progress through their career and life-stages.
  • Build long-term relationships by understanding clients’ financial needs and aspirations and delivering tailored wealth and investment solutions.
  • Share timely market insights and investment updates from the Chief Investment Office (CIO) to help clients make informed decisions.
  • Leverage digital tools such as myWealth to create customised portfolios and monitor performance based on CIO guidance.
  • Deliver exceptional client experiences through proactive engagement and personalised service.

Skills And Experience

  • Relevant experience with a minimum of two years in client acquisition, relationship management, and retail banking.
  • Technical expertise in consumer banking products, including treasury, equities, funds, and insurance.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective client relationships.
  • Proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, international environment.
  • Local market knowledge with established client networks and understanding of regional dynamics.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4470688536.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Manager Open Banking.

Principal responsibilities

Third-Party Service Providers (TSPs) Onboarding

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for Open Banking TSPs, including registration data capture, and coordinate technical and business readiness through to a safe, controlled go-live.
  • Coordinate screening, due diligence and risk reviews across stakeholders (e.g., Third Party Qualification, RPM, Cyber/TPSR), including risk evaluation scoring, ensuring outcomes, actions and approvals are completed and audit-ready.
  • Drive operational and technical enablement by coordinating terms & conditions/bilateral agreements and completing onboarding prerequisites (e.g., certificate set-up and required tool updates) to enable connectivity.
  • Manage ongoing TSP lifecycle governance and partner support, including periodic due diligence, renewals and exits/service closure, acting as the day-to-day point of contact for TSP and business queries.

Support Business Operations

  • Improve the onboarding experience by optimising the end-to-end digital onboarding journey, maintaining onboarding content (FAQs, web content, guidelines), and reducing drop-offs.
  • Use data to drive action by translating dashboards and reports into insights that inform prioritisation, support campaign targeting, and coordinate execution across commercialisation, marketing and servicing to grow adoption and usage.
  • Maintain platform operations and stability by supporting service activities including developer portal updates, MI/performance reporting, incident/problem coordination, BCM readiness and change management.

Requirements

  • Understanding of Open Banking.
  • Third-party supplier / vendor management.
  • TSP screening and due diligence including Third Party Qualification checks, review of relevant risk per RPM and engagement of Cybersecurity for TPSR review.
  • Risk Evaluation.
  • MI & analytics.
  • Strong stakeholder management.
  • Strong communication skills.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4471623228.descriptionHtml:
DBS Tech China is hiring a deeply technical, hands-on engineering leader to drive key wealth management initiatives and investment journeys. This role is suited to a strong full stack engineer who can own a stream end to end, lead one or more engineering squads, and stay close to architecture, design, and implementation.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead end-to-end architecture and solution design for Avaloq Banking Suite, translating business requirements into scalable and robust banking solutions.
  • Act as the technical lead for one or more Avaloq delivery squads, driving engineering excellence, platform stability, and solution quality.
  • Design and implement scalable solutions using Avaloq scripting, PL/SQL, Avaloq object modeling, workflow configurations, and extension frameworks.
  • Partner closely with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and operations teams to translate business requirements into robust Avaloq solutions.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, security standards, risk controls, and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee integration design across Avaloq and surrounding banking platforms through APIs, middleware, messaging systems, market data providers, and third-party applications.
  • Contribute directly to complex incident resolution, production stability improvements, and platform optimization initiatives.
  • Perform parameterization and customization in Avaloq Core Banking Platform
  • Analyse business requirements and design / propose software solutions
  • Design, build and maintain efficient, reusable and reliable code to ensure best possible performance and quality
  • Provide technical expertise and support for internal and external stakeholders
  • Mentor and coach team members
  • Assist project / programme managers in project planning & project strategies

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on Avaloq Core Banking Platform development experience with successful delivery of multiple Avaloq implementation, enhancement, or transformation programmes.
  • Deep expertise in Avaloq Core Banking Platform, including architecture, functional modules, customization, parametrization, scripting, object modelling, workflows, and configuration frameworks.
  • Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, with proven experience designing and optimizing database solutions within Avaloq environments.
  • Proven track record leading Avaloq solution design and technical delivery across multiple product domains, workstreams, or programmes.
  • Experience leading engineering teams or technology domains within banking, wealth management, or private banking environments.
  • Strong understanding of private banking products, wealth management processes, and core banking operations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with business, operations, technology, architecture, vendors, and senior leadership.
  • Ability to balance strategic architectural decision-making with hands-on technical leadership and delivery execution.
  • Strong communication, mentoring, and coaching skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

Location:

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Technology

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

ln:4470511117.descriptionHtml:
We want to hear from you if…

You are in your penultimate year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline from a top academic institution (graduating between Dec 2027 - June 2028)

Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit...

A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking, and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you. We'll also be looking for the following:

  • Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn, and success in team environments
  • Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills
  • Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry
  • Unquestioned commitment to integrity and ethical decision-making


We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program runs for 10 weeks and begins with initial classroom based training, followed by ongoing training sessions throughout the length of the program, as well as a series of networking and social events. Analysts will complete two rotations across different teams within the Corporate Banking group. Incoming Summer Analysts have the opportunity to be considered for a position on the following year’s full-time Analyst Program.

Your time here will look something like this...

  • Provide advice: this involves working with our clients to develop and execute their strategic objectives. We advise them on a number of areas including whether to buy or sell companies or assets, how to restructure finances, and where and how to invest capital
  • Work with Capital Markets: we work very closely with the Citi CMO team (Capital Markets Origination) to help our clients raise capital in the equity and debt capital markets


You're the brains behind our work.

You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can’t come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team, and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when. Citi is looking for Summer Interns to join the Corporate Banking team in Asia Pacific. Citi’s Corporate Bank is a leading provider of financial services to top-tier multi-national clients around the globe, serving the financial needs of the world's preeminent corporations and financial institutions. The Corporate group advises corporate clients who want to raise funds in capital markets and who need strategic support in financial transactions. Initiatives you may be working on with clients include mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, financial restructurings, underwriting, and distributing equity, debt, and derivative securities. As a Summer Analyst, you will join an intensive ten-week program where you will receive in-depth education on a variety of these topics to learn the fundamentals of the Analyst role and introduce you to Citi’s culture.

We encourage early applications as we recruit on a rolling basis. Each applicant can apply to maximum of 3 summer internship programs in APAC region.

Job Family Group

Institutional Banking

Job Family

Corporate Banking

Time Type

Full time

Most Relevant Skills

Please see the requirements listed above.

Other Relevant Skills

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.

View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster.
